title: The seawall at dawn
logline: The seawall at dawn in tourist season before the tourists: wet, empty, the crow, a man in plaid from behind at the rail with a thermos, the pup. The hour the town is theirs.

panels.composition: A seawall at dawn, wet and empty, a crow on the wall, a man in plaid from behind leaning on the rail with a thermos, a small three-legged dog at his boot.
